title: Appaṭividitā
text: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Yesaṃ dhammā appaṭividitā || paravādesu nīyare || suttā te nappabujjhanti || kālo tesaṃ {pabujjhitun} ti || || Yesaṃ dhammā suppaṭividitā || paravādesu na nīyare || {te sambuddhā} sammadaññā || caranti visame saman ti || ||
